packageRules.description: Ignore own images managed by Flux ImageUpdateAutomation
apple-health-lake: Flux ImageUpdateAutomation is suspended for this app (private registry), Renovate manages its image tags instead

velero-plugin-for-aws: pinned to v1.14.0 (see comment in infrastructure/velero/release.yaml) - every version from v1.14.1 through at least v1.14.3 sends an x-amz-tagging header on every PutObject that Backblaze B2 rejects, silently breaking all backups. Do not auto-merge past v1.14.0 without confirming the B2 incompatibility is actually fixed upstream.
